# axm docs

Manage Context docs package extensions.

## When to use

Use this command family when installing or publishing reusable files and project context.

## Usage

```bash
axm docs <subcommand> [flags]
```

## Arguments

None.

## Flags

None.

Global flags are documented on [Global flags](global-flags).

## Examples

**Install a docs package**

```bash
axm docs install @acme/docs/workspace-baseline
```

## Subcommands

| Command                              | Summary                                                   |
| ------------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| [axm docs install](docs/install)     | Install docs packages                                     |
| [axm docs uninstall](docs/uninstall) | Uninstall a docs package                                  |
| [axm docs list](docs/list)           | List installed docs packages                              |
| [axm docs enable](docs/enable)       | Enable a docs package                                     |
| [axm docs disable](docs/disable)     | Disable a docs package without removing sync-once targets |
| [axm docs update](docs/update)       | Update configured docs packages                           |
| [axm docs new](docs/new)             | Scaffold a new docs package                               |
| [axm docs publish](docs/publish)     | Publish a docs package                                    |
| [axm docs prune](docs/prune)         | Prune stale docs lock entries                             |

## Requirements

- workspace

## Side effects

None.
